treatment_setting_evidence.quote: PEP-CMV Vaccine Targeting CMV Antigen to Treat Newly Diagnosed Pediatric HGG and DIPG and Recurrent Medulloblastoma

agents.drug_class_hint: CMV pp65 synthetic long peptide cancer vaccine in Montanide ISA 51 emulsion
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: targets CMV antigen pp65 as immunotherapy

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive standard chemotherapy with temozolomide for five days, followed by the study vaccine, PEP-CMV, on day 21.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent; one dose-intensified course before vaccination

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive a tetanus diphtheria (Td) booster vaccine and a small dose Td preconditioning vaccine to prepare their immune system to receive their first PEP-CMV vaccine.

agents.drug_class_hint: Td toxoid vaccine used for injection-site immune preconditioning

coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult trial (ages 3-39; stdAges CHILD, ADULT). Glioblastoma named only as an example within the newly diagnosed HGG stratum (stratum II, closed) in the inclusion criteria; other strata are DIPG and recurrent medulloblastoma (non-glioma), so coded basket_gbm_eligible; mixed_glioma_gbm_named is the alternative (both include). Only investigational agent is the PEP-CMV peptide vaccine (excluded type). Temozolomide: 'standard chemotherapy' given to all before vaccination, coded soc_backbone (it is a 200 mg/m2 x5 single course rather than Stupp; it might be argued as part of the vaccine-priming strategy, but it is not a candidate either way). Td vaccine is an immune preconditioning agent, not a cancer vaccine; coded supportive (could alternatively be excluded_intervention_type). Montanide ISA 51 adjuvant is a vaccine component, not listed. Treatment setting 'both' at trial level; the GBM-containing stratum is newly diagnosed. H3K27-altered DMG is an example diagnosis, not a requirement; no biomarker rows.
